item.title: Small Wins, Deep Work, and the Fibonacci Flow
item.description:
Small Wins, Deep Work, and the Fibonacci Flow

A System for Sustainable Progress

Balancing small wins with deep, meaningful work is one of the toughest challenges professionals face — especially as teams grow and responsibilities multiply.

🧠 The Shift From Simplicity to Chaos

When you join a new team or company, you usually start with just one or two threads of work. Context switching is minimal. You focus, deliver, and succeed — as long as you’re sincere.

item.title: Using AI: How It’s Changing the Way I Think
item.description:
Over the past few months, I’ve been using AI for a variety of tasks — from writing code and documentation to brainstorming and drafting blog posts like this one.

Sometimes, I find myself overestimating AI’s capabilities — expecting it to handle complex tasks with ease. Other times, I underestimate it — thinking it won’t manage even the simplest steps. In reality, its capabilities are evolving daily. But in our rush to judge how powerful or limited AI is, we’ve mostly overlooked something important: its impact on our own thinking.

item.title: Why Performance Optimization Deserves Your Focus
item.description:
🧭 My Journey Through the Evolution of Data Engineering

Over the last 12 years, I’ve worked across Oracle, Informatica, Redshift, Spark, and modern big data stacks. My teams have owned and operated mission-critical data pipelines — pipelines that often held the fate of dashboards, reports, and leadership decisions.

There were countless nights when things went wrong — a fix was made, and we had no option but to wait several hours to validate if it actually worked. Sample runs weren’t enough. Real validation needed full data processing. And until the pipelines completed, no one had answers.
